tasks.title: Upsert appended fix tasks into the evidence ledger
tasks.intent: A task that is not yet in the evidence ledger (a fix task appended after the ledger was created) is added when its evidence is recorded, instead of being dropped by `withUpdatedTask`, so `validationSummary` and the closed block's "N/M briefs validated" count every brief that passed.
exclusions: Do not change the ledger schema or the evidence.json file shape.
Do not change the closed block copy; the count must come right from the ledger.
Do not keep two seeding paths: record-checks.ts uses the same helper after the change.
steps: Add one upsert helper in ledger-state.ts (replace the entry when its id exists, else append it), and recompute validationSummary there.
Use it at the callers in evidence/task.ts that do `findOrSeed` then `withUpdatedTask(..., () => next)`, and replace the inline seeding in record-checks.ts with it.
Test: a ledger seeded with T001–T002, then recordLocalTaskEvidence for a fix task T003 with status done: the ledger has 3 tasks and validationSummary counts 3 passed.

tasks.title: Queue confirmation names the seat that receives the message
tasks.intent: When the composer queues a message, the confirmation names the seat the placeholder names: during the final review it reads that the message is queued for the reviewer, because `drainQueueForReview` delivers it to the reviewer; for the planner it keeps the planner wording.
exclusions: Do not change which seat the queue delivers to.
Do not add a second function that decides the seat: the placeholder and the confirmation read one role decision.
steps: Expose the role decision `queuePlaceholder` already makes (input-hints.ts) as one helper, and have the confirmation in review-parser.ts (`Message queued for the next planner turn.`) read it: 'Message queued for the reviewer.' for the validator role, the planner sentence otherwise.

tasks.title: Pause-after-brief byline names the brief that just finished
tasks.intent: With Pause after this brief armed, after the running brief completes and while the batch-boundary suite runs, the stop byline reads `Finishing <last brief id>` instead of `Finishing the run`; `the run` stays only when no brief ran.
exclusions: Do not change selectRunningBrief's meaning for the stop sheet rows (UI-DEBT #29 fix).
Do not change the keys or the stop sheet rows.
steps: In use-stop-byline.ts, when the intent is pause-after-brief and no brief is in progress, pass the most recently completed brief of the run as the subject (read it from the tasks store; add a selector there only if none exists).
Test: tasks T001 done, T002 done, T003 done (batch boundary), intent pause-after-brief → lead `Finishing T003`.

tasks.title: A cut, redacted value is never redacted again
tasks.intent: `redactSecrets` treats an assignment value that is a cut prefix of the redaction marker or ends in the ellipsis of a cut as already redacted, so a value sanitized, cut with truncateTerminalDisplayText and sanitized again by cardRowsLayout/rowsBlock keeps its width; the `BUILD failed` card for `error: 'x'.repeat(width - 28) + ' password=x'` renders one row at 60, 80 and 120 columns.
exclusions: Do not weaken redaction of real secrets: an uncut credential value must still be redacted.
Do not remove the second sanitize pass in cardRowsLayout or rowsBlock.
steps: Extend the already-redacted guard in replaceAssignedSecret (redact.ts:105-111) to a non-empty prefix of the marker followed by the ellipsis, and to a lone ellipsis value.
Test in redact.test.ts: `password=***RED…` and `password=…` are unchanged; `password=hunter2` is still redacted.
Test in dispatch.test.ts: the repro renders one row at 60, 80, 120.

Reuse the `usageLimitIssue` helper already in recovery-prompt.test.ts; do not add a new fixture factory.

tasks.intent: runFullSuite publishes `full_suite` running and done events (stage, command, moment: baseline | boundary | pre-review, duration and pass/fail on done) for every stage it runs; the transcript shows one `Suite` row per stage run (the done event replaces its running entry), the token switch handles it, and while a suite stage runs the status line names it (for example `Running the test suite · npm test`) instead of `Implementing…` or `Finishing the run`.
exclusions: Do not add an ETA or a progress fraction.
Do not change suite timeouts, baseline handling or acceptance.
Model the event on validation_baseline (running/done, merged in the events store); do not add a second running-entry merge mechanism.
steps: Add the `full_suite` event to the schema and a publisher in orchestrator/events.ts; runFullSuite takes the moment from its callers (loop.ts baseline, batch-boundary.ts, pre-review-checks.ts) and publishes per stage.
Row: one dim `Suite` row naming stage, command and, when done, pass/fail and duration; mergeIntoTail replaces the running entry.
phase-verb.ts and the operations reducer: an open full_suite stage names the stage as the activity.
